author: DamiLee
description:
The Colosseum wasn't just built for spectacle. It was built to remind you of your place.

The Romans stacked three Greek column styles on the facade, each one tied to a different layer of their social order. Strength at the base, elegance in the middle, imperial authority at the top. Every time you walked in, the building itself was telling you how Rome worked.

Architecture as propaganda. Hidden in plain sight for 2,000 years.
